Dash Bicycle First Sunday Ride

Providence, RI · Federal Hill · Road

Dash Bicycle First Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Providence, RI. It rolls first Sunday of the month at 10:00 am from Dash Bicycle Shop. About 20–30 miles, slightly faster, free-form.

About the Dash Bicycle First Sunday Ride group ride

A free-form monthly road ride into the rural roads outside Providence, adjusted to how the group feels. Helmets mandatory, lycra not. The shop's Wednesday 7 am no-drop recovery ride is paused until spring; check Instagram for updates.
